en_how: Each glass slide is a toneMap drawing engraved with three layers of hatchLines and hand-tinted with blurred transparent washes; every frame shows it inside a circular light spot in a pitch-dark hall, flickering with noise like an oil lamp with a dark edge, the second slide slides in sideways, then it dissolves into a chromatrope of two counter-rotating colour discs while the camera pulls back to reveal the screen, red curtains, the projector beam and audience silhouettes.
